description: Shanghai Futures Exchange daily warehouse-receipt (warrant) stocks: gold and silver in kilograms, base metals, rebar, hot-rolled coil and other products in tonnes, with the day-over-day change and the per-warehouse breakdown. This is stock made into warrants for delivery, not total physical inventory. Pass a product code or name (au, ag, rb, copper...) for the full breakdown, or omit it for a one-line total per product. Defaults to the latest published report.

date.description: Report day, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD. Omit for the latest published report.

product.description: Product code or name: "au" or "gold", "ag" or "silver", "rb", "cu"... Omit for every product's total.

name: cn_futures_warehouse_stocks
